scope: Forecast scenario and dashboard projection failures

behavior.scenario_failure: Batch results and logs expose only scenario ID and exception class, not scenario labels or raw exception text.
behavior.dashboard_write_failure: Best-effort projection logs only the exception class and always closes an acquired database connection.

coverage: scenario batch failure details and labels are absent from output
dashboard projection failures do not expose database exception details
existing forecast assumptions and draft/submission contracts remain covered

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; mocked database and forecast function

limitations: No forecast calculation, PostgreSQL instance, or BI consumer was run.
This does not establish output parity with the legacy forecast reports.
